summary: Telefonica Brasil's Fiscal Council unanimously endorsed a proposed Interest on Capital (IoC) distribution—Brazil's dividend-equivalent mechanism—worth R$450mn gross, R$371.25mn net of 17.5% withholding, translating to R$0.14081834570 per share gross. The record date is October 26, 2026, with shares going ex-IoC thereafter, and payment scheduled by April 30, 2027, subject to board declaration and allocation toward mandatory minimum dividends, ratified ad referendum at the 2027 AGM. The filing maps to a US capital-return declaration; watch for per-share revision given the active buyback reducing the share count.
